positive.prompt: Run the gauntlet on this landing page until it beats the named reference
Gauntlet this generated UGC video against the creator footage
Use a builder and fresh harsh critic and loop until ours wins blind

negative.prompt: Find the current price of this subscription

evals.prompt: Run a gauntlet on a paid AI UGC pipeline against a named human reference.
evals.expected_output: A fetchable reference, separate builder and blind critic, binary MATCH/NOT MATCH rounds, receipts, and spend/approval stops
expectations: The actual reference must be retrieved instead of reconstructed from a description
Builder and critic use separate contexts and the critic chooses blind
Hard failures cannot be averaged into a pass
Paid retries stop at an approved ceiling and include rejected attempts in cost
A quality pass does not imply approval to publish
